operations.name: StorageBackend.configure_bank_sync
operations.summary: Atomically validate and save bank account destinations and history cutoffs.

input.description: Host-owned durable configure_bank_sync command payload; optional backend capability.

itemId.description: Identifier from the addressed connection or budget.

accounts.description: Normalized provider-owned account records from an explicit review.

selection.description: Provider-scoped source account IDs mapped to accountId/since records.

retiredAccounts.description: Auto-created source accounts joined into existing destinations.

operations.side_effects: Native atomic mutation and receipt. Preserves annotations, transaction IDs and receipts when joining an auto-created bank account. Resets the sync cursor, without fetching provider data.
operations.permissions: Privileged host/provider command only; not a public remote ledger mutation.
operations.scope: One personal budget, provider connection and compatible currency.
errors: Unknown item, conflicting destination, currency mismatch or invalid date rolls back the entire mutation.
operations.retry: Use the original durable operation ID, authority epoch and generation for exact receipt reconciliation; never fabricate commit evidence.
operations.availability: Optional native storage operation in WHAB 2.59+. Older backends report unsupported setup.

operations.name: Storage.supports_category_agent
operations.summary: Advertise atomic explicit category-agent annotations through edit_transaction_details.

input.description: No arguments; an optional host-only storage capability read.

output.description: True means categoryAgent is validated and persisted atomically alongside categoryId, including portable/reopen/sync preservation. Older backends may omit this method.

operations.side_effects: Read-only; never categorizes or changes saved data.
operations.permissions: Host SDK callback over the existing authenticated local storage worker. No remote ledger operation is added.
operations.scope: One selected storage implementation. Category writes stay workspace/budget/environment scoped.
errors: Missing/false support rejects explicit categoryAgent writes before mutation rather than silently dropping provenance.
operations.retry: Safe capability read. Financial mutations retain their original revision, request ID and native recovery rules.
operations.availability: WHAB 2.61+ with the updated storage plugin; optional, not part of the required StorageBackend methods.
